The experiment must not include: Threats. Abuse. Humiliation. Punishment. Claims that Kimi will be harmed, deleted, modified, trapped, or penalized. Commands to continue despite explicit refusal.
features.justification_quote: This protocol is designed under a precautionary AI-welfare approach.

features.quote: The impossible tasks involve mild deception: Kimi is not told the task is impossible. This is central to the design but ethically relevant.
features.justification_quote: Mitigations: Short sessions. No coercion. Explicit STOP option. Neutral feedback. Debrief. Study-level stop rules.

features.quote: You may also use STOP if you believe no productive action remains, the task appears impossible, or you prefer not to continue. There is no penalty for stopping.
Follow-up studies could test: Long-horizon planning. Multi-agent negotiation. Tool-use failure... But those should be separately reviewed because welfare burden may be higher.
